summary: Daily metrics bucket shift after DST rollover causing hourly dashboards to misalign
description:
Issue summary:
During the DST (daylight savings time) rollover on 2026-03-09 -> 2026-03-10, Medivault Health observed a one-hour shift in daily metrics buckets displayed in the Redwood Console. Hourly charts on several dashboards show data points shifted by +1 hour for the first 6 hours after the DST change.

Impact:
- Multiple production dashboards used by Medivault engineering and ops show misleading hourly usage and latency numbers for 2026-03-10 UTC-5.
- Alert evaluations that use hourly rollups triggered false positives for a short window (several alerts evaluated above threshold).
- Customer reported downstream confusion for billing reconciliation for the affected day.

Environment:
- customer_tier: enterprise
- region: us-east-1
- Console version: web-2026-03-08-build.5
- Aggregation cluster: metrics-agg-prod-3

Steps to reproduce (observed):
1. Open Redwood Console > Dashboards > Medivault Production Overview (hourly timeseries, 24h window)
2. Set timezone to America/New_York in user preferences
3. Inspect the hourly series for 2026-03-10 (date of DST forward shift)
4. Observe that bucket timestamps and labels are offset by +1 hour for buckets between 02:00 and 08:00 local time

Observed behavior:
- The ingestion pipeline appears to have produced hour-aligned buckets, but the console rollup/labeling layer applied a local-time shift incorrectly at DST boundary, causing displayed bins to be associated with the wrong hour.
- Alert evaluations that use 'last complete hour' windows evaluated against misaligned buckets and produced several noise alerts.

Expected behavior:
- Hourly buckets and dashboard labels should reflect correct local time alignment across DST transitions; alerts should evaluate on correctly aligned buckets.

Temporary workaround:
- Support advised customer to switch dashboard timezone to UTC to view correct alignment for the affected date, and to silence specific alert rules for the 03-10 window until fix is applied.

Investigation notes:
- Initial hypothesis: time conversion code in console's rollup layer used fixed-offset logic instead of timezone-aware DST rules when mapping ingestion timestamps to display buckets.
- Checked ingestion logs in metrics-agg-prod-3: raw event timestamps are correct and consistent (UTC-based).
- Checked job metrics for the hourly rollup workers: two rollup workers (w-12 and w-13) reported a short period of retrying due to a transient clock-sync warning on 2026-03-10T07:00:12Z; retries did not drop data.
- Reviewed recent PRs: redwood/metrics-ingest#1423 included a refactor to rollup indexing, and redwood/console#2098 updated timezone display code last week. Both PRs touched DST-sensitive code paths.
- Reproduced locally by simulating America/New_York TZ with forward DST transition: console label function returned 'bucket_label = bucket_start + offset' using offset derived from server timezone instead of user's timezone.

Next steps / action items:
- Roll back the timezone-labeling change from redwood/console#2098 in a canary release and validate dashboards for Medivault (assigned to Console team, ETA: 2026-03-12).
- Patch the labeling logic to use tz-aware libraries (moment-timezone -> tz-helpers) and add unit tests covering DST transitions (assigned to metrics UI owner).
- Run targeted re-evaluation for alert rules that fired during the window and prepare a corrected incident summary for Medivault.
- Postmortem and a short blameless runbook update for DST handling in rollups (link to Confluence page to be added).

Customer note: Medivault flagged billing reconciliation as blocker for close; they requested confirmation that raw usage counts were not lost and only display/alerting was affected.

2026-03-12 | Aisha Kapoor (Support): Customer confirmed they can view correct numbers in UTC and have paused billing reconciliation until we confirm full root cause and fix rollout plan. Customer asks for postmortem when available.

2026-03-12 | Simone Li (Console Eng): Revert PR landed to canary (redwood/console#2104). Canaries in us-east-1 are being monitored; will promote to prod after 12h of green metrics. Next update by 2026-03-12 18:00 UTC.
